name: Ooki Shuu
source:
The protagonist's homeroom teacher.
His subject is geography.
He often says 'I trust my students', but it's more of an excuse he makes to slack off as a teacher.
He was made the advisor of the cultural festival committee this year and is always getting chased around by the committee chairman.
